description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from in vivo electrophysiological recordings in mouse cortex using multielectrode arrays, including LFP, spike trains, stimulus context, and behavioral task annotations.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record (e.g., session-001-epoch-03 or unit-12).

dataset_record_type.descr: Type of record described by this row; e.g., session, electrode, unit, trial, epoch, or stimulus_event.

experiment_date.descr: Date of the recording or experimental observation (YYYY-MM-DD).

animal_id.descr: Unique identifier for the mouse subject.

species.descr: Species of the subject; expected value: Mus musculus.

strain.descr: Mouse strain or line; e.g., C57BL/6J, transgenic line name.

sex.descr: Biological sex of the subject; e.g., male, female, unknown.

age_days.descr: Age of the mouse at time of recording, in days.

weight_g.descr: Body weight of the mouse at time of recording, in grams.

subject_genotype.descr: Genotype or transgene status of the subject, if applicable.

anesthesia_used.descr: Whether anesthesia was used during the recording.

anesthesia_agent.descr: Name of anesthetic agent(s), if used; e.g., isoflurane, ketamine/xylazine.

awake_or_anesthetized.descr: State of the animal during recording; e.g., awake, anesthetized, lightly sedated.

brain_region.descr: Recorded cortical area; e.g., primary visual cortex, medial prefrontal cortex, motor cortex.

brain_region_abbreviation.descr: Standard abbreviation for the cortical area, if used; e.g., V1, mPFC, M1.

cortical_layer.descr: Cortical layer targeted or recorded from; e.g., L2/3, L4, L5, L6.

electrode_array_type.descr: Type or model of multielectrode array used for recording.

electrode_count.descr: Total number of electrodes or channels in the array.

electrode_impedance_kohm.descr: Electrode impedance in kilo-ohms (kΩ), typically measured at a reference frequency.

electrode_depth_um.descr: Insertion depth of the electrode array in micrometers (µm).

electrode_coordinates.descr: Electrode location coordinates in a reference space; recommended as a compact object such as {"ap_mm":..., "ml_mm":..., "dv_mm":...} or similar.

recording_modality.descr: Recorded signal type; e.g., LFP, spike train, multi-unit activity, single-unit activity.

lfp_present.descr: Whether local field potential data are included in this record.

spike_trains_present.descr: Whether spike train data are included in this record.

sampling_rate_hz.descr: Sampling rate of the recorded continuous signal in hertz (Hz).

lfp_bandpass_low_hz.descr: Low cutoff frequency used for LFP extraction or filtering, in Hz.

lfp_bandpass_high_hz.descr: High cutoff frequency used for LFP extraction or filtering, in Hz.

spike_sorting_method.descr: Method used to detect and/or sort spikes; e.g., thresholding, Kilosort, manual curation.

spike_unit_id.descr: Identifier for the sorted spike unit, if applicable.

spike_unit_quality.descr: Quality label for the spike unit; e.g., good, multi-unit, noise, unsorted.

firing_rate_hz.descr: Mean firing rate for the unit or epoch, in spikes per second (Hz).

spike_count.descr: Total number of spikes detected in the record or epoch.

waveform_peak_to_trough_us.descr: Spike waveform peak-to-trough duration in microseconds (µs), if measured.

trial_id.descr: Identifier for the behavioral trial associated with this record, if applicable.

task_name.descr: Behavioral task name; e.g., decision-making task, go/no-go, two-alternative choice.

task_phase.descr: Task phase or epoch; e.g., baseline, stimulus, delay, choice, reward.

stimulus_type.descr: Type of stimulus presented; e.g., visual, auditory, tactile, optogenetic.

stimulus_description.descr: Free-text description of the stimulus, including modality and salient features.

stimulus_onset_time_s.descr: Stimulus onset time relative to record start or trial start, in seconds.

stimulus_intensity.descr: Stimulus intensity or strength in appropriate units for the modality; include units in the accompanying description in practice.

stimulus_frequency_hz.descr: Stimulus frequency in hertz (Hz), if applicable.

stimulus_orientation_deg.descr: Stimulus orientation in degrees (°), if applicable.

behavior_annotation.descr: Behavioral annotation for this record; e.g., running, grooming, left choice, right choice, correct, incorrect.

behavior_state.descr: Broader behavioral state during the recording; e.g., quiescent, locomoting, engaged, disengaged.

reaction_time_s.descr: Reaction time for the behavioral response, in seconds.

movement_speed_cm_s.descr: Measured movement speed during the record or trial, in centimeters per second (cm/s).

lick_response.descr: Whether a lick response occurred during the trial.

reward_delivered.descr: Whether reward was delivered during the trial.

reward_type.descr: Type of reward delivered; e.g., water, sucrose.

outcome.descr: Trial outcome; e.g., correct, incorrect, omission, aborted.

recording_start_time_s.descr: Start time of the recorded segment relative to session start, in seconds.

recording_end_time_s.descr: End time of the recorded segment relative to session start, in seconds.

recording_duration_s.descr: Total duration of the recorded segment, in seconds.

time_base_reference.descr: Reference clock or alignment source used for timestamps; e.g., acquisition clock, behavioral clock, synchronized master clock.

event_alignment_reference.descr: Reference event used to align times; e.g., stimulus onset, trial start, response onset.

data_file_name.descr: Name of the primary data file associated with this record.

data_file_path.descr: Relative or absolute path to the raw or processed data file.

data_format.descr: File format of the data; e.g., NWB, HDF5, MAT, CSV, binary.

processing_stage.descr: Processing level of the data; e.g., raw, filtered, spike-sorted, curated, derived.

quality_control_flag.descr: Whether this record passed quality control.

quality_control_notes.descr: Notes describing any QC issues, exclusions, or caveats.

experimenter_id.descr: Identifier or name of the primary experimenter.

laboratory_name.descr: Name of the laboratory or institution where the recording was produced.

protocol_id.descr: Identifier for the experimental protocol or standard operating procedure used.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to this specific record.
